peter1.1.p1.b2.text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, chosen

peter1.1.p1.b3.text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit … Grace and peace be yours in abundance.

peter1.1.p2.b1.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ!

peter1.1.p2.b2.text: By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

peter1.1.p2.b3.text: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,

peter1.1.p2.b4.text: who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.

peter1.1.p3.b1.text: … though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials

peter1.1.p3.b2.text: so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire— …

peter1.1.p3.b3.text: Though you have not seen Him, you love Him; … you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,

peter1.1.p3.b4.text: now that you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

peter1.1.p4.b1.text: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,

peter1.1.p4.b2.text: trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.

peter1.1.p4.b3.text: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you,

peter1.1.p4.b4.text: … Even angels long to look into these things.

peter1.1.p5.b1.text: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

peter1.1.p5.b2.text: … do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.

peter1.1.p5.b3.text: But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,

peter1.1.p5.b4.text: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”

peter1.1.p6.b1.text: Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.

peter1.1.p6.b2.text: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed …

peter1.1.p6.b3.text: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.

peter1.1.p6.b4.text: Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God.

peter1.1.p7.b1.text: … love one another deeply, from a pure heart.

peter1.1.p7.b2.text: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.

peter1.1.p7.b3.text: … “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,

peter1.1.p7.b4.text: but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
